'''2001 European Championship''' (players called it Continentals) was the 2001 Star Wars CCG European Continental Championship in Paris, France. Day 1 had 74 players over eight rounds. Day 2 had 26 players, then a final between the top two.<ref name="tr-bw">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-01-european-championships-paris-last-weekd2911/ european-championships-paris-last-week], Bastian "Death Star" Winkelhaus, DeckTech (1 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-01-european-championships-paris-last-weekd2911/ GitHub Pages].</ref><ref name="tr-jr">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-28-european-continental-2001-i-am-not-ind2904/ european-continental-2001-i-am-not-in], Julien "Dark Padawan" Riviere, DeckTech (28 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-28-european-continental-2001-i-am-not-ind2904/ GitHub Pages].</ref> [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] won, beating [[Peter Di Biasio]] in the final.<ref name="tr-bw" /><ref name="dt-18727">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18727 Watto by Winkelhaus], DeckTech (Bastian "Death Star" Winkelhaus, 1 September 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18727/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18727/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 25–26 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Paris, France
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]

The dates come from the reports: Riviere posted his on 28 August 2001, and Winkelhaus wrote on 1 September that the event was "last week". Day 1 was the Saturday and Day 2 the Sunday.<ref name="tr-jr" /><ref name="tr-bw" />

Winkelhaus wrote that his Dark deck beat [[Martin Falke]] twice, by 31 and 33, and Di Biasio in the final by 38.<ref name="dt-18727" /> Falke was 4–0 on Day 2 before losing both games against Winkelhaus. In the second he played Dark [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|My Lord, Is That Legal?]].<ref name="tr-bw" /><ref name="dt-18723" />
